definition: In this historical source, static sense refers to the bodily sense involved in keeping balance and maintaining an upright posture. It is linked especially to the semicircular canals of the ear and their role in supporting the muscular tone needed for equilibrium.

provenance.revision: 1901 New York Macmillan original; archive index checked 2026-10-18
provenance.scope: Source record Equilibrium(sensation); pinned source text
